AI design tools `help you build layouts, interfaces, and graphics quickly using text prompts`.[[1]](https://www.canva.com/magic-design/)[[2]](https://www.figma.com/solutions/ai-design-generator/)[[3]](https://www.adobe.com/products/firefly/features/ai-graphic-design-generator.html)

### UI, Wireframe, and App Design

- **[Figma Make](https://www.figma.com/solutions/ai-design-generator/):** Turns text prompts or codebases into real layouts, interactive prototypes, and working code.
- **Google Stitch:** Fast, free tool for mocking up web or app layouts and transitioning concepts into Figma.
- **Flowstep:** Builds multi-screen UX structures with code export for React, Tailwind, and MCP.
- **Uizard / Visily:** Rapid AI mockup and wireframe generators for non-designers and product teams.[[1]](https://medium.muz.li/6-best-ai-ui-design-tools-i-tested-with-the-same-prompt-2026-review-b68309af284a)[[2]](https://www.figma.com/solutions/ai-design-generator/)[[3]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=tUsTsCVbr2Y)[[4]](https://open-design.ai/blog/best-ai-design-tools/)

### Code-First and Website Builders

- **v0 (by Vercel):** Generates polished, component-based, production-close UI code from prompts.
- **Lovable / Bolt.new:** Focuses on interactive follow-up questions and rapid MVP or interface building.
- **Framer:** Popular AI-driven website builder that turns ideas into live, responsive sites.[[1]](https://open-design.ai/blog/best-ai-design-tools/)[[2]](https://medium.muz.li/6-best-ai-ui-design-tools-i-tested-with-the-same-prompt-2026-review-b68309af284a)

### Graphic Design and Visual Creation

- **[Canva Magic Design](https://www.canva.com/magic-design/):** Auto-generates on-brand presentations, social graphics, and videos using your Brand Kit.
- **Midjourney:** High-detail visual generation ideal for conceptual art and product shots.
- **[Adobe Firefly](https://www.adobe.com/products/firefly/features/ai-graphic-design-generator.html):** Integrated AI art generator built directly into the Adobe Creative Cloud workflow.
- **Designs.ai:** All-in-one suite for creating logos, videos, banners, and voiceovers.[[1]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=tUsTsCVbr2Y)[[2]](https://www.canva.com/magic-design/)[[3]](https://www.adobe.com/products/firefly/features/ai-graphic-design-generator.html)[[4]](http://designs.ai/)
